issue.title: MCP tool dispatch error handler loses error type — all exceptions look like plain strings
issue.actual_behavior: In chip_mcp_server.py lines 479-487, the tools/call exception handler catches all exceptions and returns only str(exc) inside a result.content blob. No error code, no exception type, no structured data. A ValueError is indistinguishable from a KeyError or RuntimeError to the MCP client. The response also uses the non-standard result field instead of the JSON-RPC error field.
issue.expected_behavior: The error response should use the JSON-RPC error field (matching the format used for unknown methods at code -32601) and include the exception type name so clients can programmatically distinguish error kinds.
repro_steps: Inspect chip_mcp_server.py lines 479-487: the except Exception handler returns {result: {content: [{text: {error: str(exc)}}], isError: true}}.
Trigger any exception during tool dispatch (e.g., pass invalid arguments that cause a ValueError).
Observe the response has no error code, no error_type field, and uses result instead of the standard JSON-RPC error object.
issue.affected_workflow: MCP clients cannot distinguish exception types when tool dispatch fails. Programming errors (TypeError, AttributeError) look identical to input validation errors (ValueError), making debugging and retry logic impossible.

evidence.before_after_proof: Before: except block returns {result: {content: [{text: json.dumps({error: str(exc)})}], isError: true}} — no error code, no error type. After: returns {error: {code: -32000, message: 'ValueError: bad input', data: {error_type: 'ValueError', detail: 'bad input'}}} — structured JSON-RPC error with exception type.

proposed_fix.approach: Replace the catch-all except handler to use the standard JSON-RPC error field with code -32000, include the exception class name in both message and data.error_type, and keep the original error detail in data.detail. This matches the error format used elsewhere in the same file (unknown method returns code -32601).
proposed_fix.tests_or_smoke: Two new tests added: (1) test_tools_call_error_includes_error_type — verifies error code -32000, message contains 'ValueError', data.error_type is 'ValueError', data.detail matches. (2) test_tools_call_error_distinguishes_exception_types — verifies KeyError produces error_type 'KeyError', confirming different exception types are distinguishable.

review_claim.duplicate_notes: Searched open and closed PRs in spark-domain-chip-labs for MCP error handling fixes; none found. This targets the specific tools/call exception handler that was using non-standard error format.
review_claim.risk_notes: Only changes the error response shape for exception cases. Happy path and non-exception error paths (unknown tool returns {error: ...} in result) are untouched. The -32000 code is the standard JSON-RPC server-defined error range. No secrets, CI, dependencies, or external surfaces affected.
